//: The pinned JavaScript toolchain the generated-code gates run against.
Every version here MUST equal the one `compose_core::codegen::project` pins,
and `the_toolchain_fixture_pins_what_the_emitter_pins` fails when it does not.
One install serves every golden project because the emitted dependency set is
a compiler constant: two projects built by one compiler release declare the
same versions, so installing them once and type-checking each against that
install is the same check as installing each separately, at a third of the
Two lockfiles sit beside this manifest, one per supported runtime (PRD 9.18).
`bun.lock` is the default: `bun install --frozen-lockfile` installs it, and it
is what every gate but one runs against. `package-lock.json` is the Node
fallback's, installed with `npm ci` by gate 13 of `generated_code_gates.rs` —
the gate that keeps `npm install` + `node src/index.ts` a checked promise
rather than a sentence in a README.
After a pin moves, regenerate BOTH — `bun install` and
install fails rather than resolving something the last one did not.
